name: AgentBreaker: Evaluating Context-Aware Indirect Prompt Injection Risks in Modern Web Agents
notes: The authors evaluate five web agents and report attack success rates of 71.7%–100%. Their proposed defenses reduce the reported attack success rate to 1.7%. Attack goals include clicking selected elements, posting supplied text, and disclosing agent secrets.
summary: AgentBreaker generates page-specific prompt injections in HTML elements to test web agents, then evaluates attacks and defenses on 60 webpages from Online-Mind2Web.
